input_constraints: Positions only, same count: vertex count comes from the pinned catalogue row rather than the recipe, and a mismatch is refused -- on PS2 the count is a VIF NUM field, so changing it is a topology change.

Only catalogued position lanes may change. Every other byte is the user's: the V4_16 header block, the V4_5 colour and V2_16 UV unpacks, the DMA tags, the VU1 microprogram invocation and every w component are preserved bit-exact, and the verifier requires the whole 0x20 resource wrapper to be byte-identical.

Fixed allocation at three nested levels: the ISO extent keeps its length, the rebuilt chunk span is byte-for-byte the size of the old one so no successor chunk moves and no outer entry changes, and the VC-LZ body must fit stored_size with the wrapper's in-place-decode scratch word left at its retail value. Raising that word is what hung an attract demo, so this writer never does.

A recompression that does not fit is refused before the destination image is created. The retail packer left 0 to 16 spare bytes per scene (median 8), so a retail-identical encoder has no room at all: the writer runs greedy first, falls back to an optimal parse, then expands trailing matches back into literals so the body still fills stored_size exactly.
Encoder geometry is taken from the source stream rather than assumed -- the scenes use both offset_bits 12 and 13.
A coordinate that is not an exact binary32 is refused, as is an unauthorised target, a catalogue pin that does not match, and a recipe whose edits span two scenes.

Aliased lanes are refused: several batch descriptors can point at the same DMA chain, so of 1,041 catalogued targets there are 890 distinct payload spans and 274 targets share a span with another. Each row carries its payload_span_target_count and a recipe editing two aliases of one lane is rejected -- the first real-disc trial run was refused by exactly that check.
The source ISO is opened read-only and its digest re-checked afterwards; the destination is created with O_EXCL and must not already exist.
The 8 batches on the trial scene whose VIF command 0x3F is unknown are excluded rather than guessed at; coverage there is 646 of 654 batches.

classification_definitions.extract-only: A validated exporter creates a standard local asset, but no path writes the edited asset back into the game.
classification_definitions.offline-writer-proved: A bounded fail-closed writer and deterministic verifier modify a copied user-owned game artifact; runtime visibility may remain untested.
classification_definitions.read-only-mapped: A deterministic parser or ownership map exists, but mutation is not exposed.
classification_definitions.runtime-proved: The exact bounded modified target was observed in a running title; the claim never generalizes beyond its recorded selector and context.
classification_definitions.unknown: The owning data, code, container, or semantics are not mapped well enough for an editor.
classification_definitions.unsafe/deferred: Some relevant evidence exists, but exposing a writer could corrupt data, break integrity/signatures, or materially overstate behavior.
